name: Native AI same-owner Palace to Temple MOVE and Free Cities city custody contrast

condition.code:
local plan=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')
if not plan or not plan.ID or not plan.WorkIndex then return false end
local source=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y)
local cache=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y)
return source and source:GetOwner()==plan.Work.Owner and source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot)==plan.WorkIndex
 and cache and cache:GetOwner()==plan.Free and cache:GetID()==plan.ID and cache:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)==-1

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local original=A.NativeWorkLocations(plan.WorkIndex)
assert(#original==1 and A.Rules.Equal(original[1],plan.Work),'original AI2 Palace work changed')
local carrier=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y))
assert(carrier:GetOwner()==plan.Free and carrier:GetID()==plan.ID and #A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(plan.Free)==0,'Free Cities carrier is not empty and exact')
local stage={Index=plan.WorkIndex,Source=plan.Work,Carrier={OldID=plan.ID,Owner=plan.Work.Owner,Free=plan.Free,X=plan.X,Y=plan.Y,Building=plan.Building,Slot=plan.Slot},Stage='CARRIER_TO_AI'}
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE',stage)
CityManager.TransferCity(carrier,plan.Work.Owner)
return 'empty official carrier Temple transferred to work owner for same-owner MOVE comparison'

steps.code:
local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y))
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Source.X,stage.Source.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Owner and source:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Owner
 and city:GetID()~=source:GetID(),'same-owner cities did not publish distinct IDs')
local b=city:GetBuildings()
assert(b:HasBuilding(stage.Carrier.Building) and not b:IsPillaged(stage.Carrier.Building)
 and b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(stage.Carrier.Building)==1
 and b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(stage.Carrier.Building,0)==-1,'carrier Temple changed')
local sourceBuilding=source:GetBuildings()
assert(sourceBuilding:GetGreatWorkInSlot(stage.Source.Building,stage.Source.Slot)==stage.Index,'original Palace source changed')
local object=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorks[sourceBuilding:GetGreatWorkTypeFromIndex(stage.Index)]).GreatWorkObjectType
local slotType=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[b:GetGreatWorkSlotType(stage.Carrier.Building,0)]).GreatWorkSlotType
local valid=false
for row in GameInfo.GreatWork_ValidSubTypes() do if row.GreatWorkObjectType==object and row.GreatWorkSlotType==slotType then valid=true end end
assert(valid,'official Temple incompatible with original relic')
local params={}
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE]=stage.Carrier.Owner
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_SRC]=source:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST]=city:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_SRC]=stage.Source.Building
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_DEST]=stage.Carrier.Building
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX]=stage.Index
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_SLOT]=stage.Carrier.Slot
Events.GreatWorkMoved.Add(function(...) local args={...};for i=1,#args do args[i]=tostring(args[i]) end;print('[JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_EVENT] '..table.concat(args,',')) end)
local returned=UI.RequestPlayerOperation(stage.Carrier.Owner,PlayerOperations.MOVE_GREAT_WORK,params)
ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeAIMoveTarget={Owner=stage.Carrier.Owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=stage.Carrier.Building,Slot=stage.Carrier.Slot}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_AI_SAME_OWNER_MOVE_REQUEST] actor='..stage.Carrier.Owner..' local='..Game.GetLocalPlayer()..' result='..tostring(returned)..' source='..source:GetID()..' target='..city:GetID())
return 'same-owner AI official MOVE requested; no physical success claimed'

local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
local target=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeAIMoveTarget)
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Source.X,stage.Source.Y))
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
local src=source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(stage.Source.Building,stage.Source.Slot)
local dest=city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(target.Building,target.Slot)
local count=0;local found
local owners,seen={},{};for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
if not seen[stage.Carrier.Free] then owners[#owners+1]=stage.Carrier.Free end
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
 local p=Players[owner]
 if p then for _,c in p:GetCities():Members() do
  local b=c:GetBuildings()
  for def in GameInfo.Buildings() do if b:HasBuilding(def.Index) then
   for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(def.Index)-1 do if b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(def.Index,slot)==stage.Index then count=count+1;found={Owner=owner,City=c:GetID(),X=c:GetX(),Y=c:GetY(),Building=def.Index,Slot=slot} end end
  end end
 end end
end
ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeAIMovePhysical={Count=count,Found=found,Source=src,Dest=dest,Target=target}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_AI_SAME_OWNER_MOVE_PHYSICAL] count='..count..' source='..tostring(src)..' dest='..tostring(dest)..' found='..tostring(found and found.Owner))
return 'AI same-owner MOVE physical comparison count='..count..' source='..tostring(src)..' dest='..tostring(dest)

local result=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeAIMovePhysical)
local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
assert(result.Count==1 and result.Source==-1 and result.Dest==stage.Index,'AI same-owner MOVE did not physically move original work')
local f=assert(result.Found);local t=result.Target
assert(f.Owner==t.Owner and f.City==t.City and f.X==t.X and f.Y==t.Y and f.Building==t.Building and f.Slot==t.Slot,'AI same-owner MOVE landed in another official slot')
return 'same index uniquely moved Palace to AI-owned official Temple'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
local proof=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeAIMovePhysical)
assert(proof.Count==1 and proof.Source==-1 and proof.Dest==stage.Index,'physical same-owner MOVE proof missing')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(stage.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==stage.Carrier.Owner and found[1].X==stage.Carrier.X and found[1].Y==stage.Carrier.Y and found[1].Building==stage.Carrier.Building and found[1].Slot==stage.Carrier.Slot,'Core did not observe original index in carrier Temple')
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Owner and city:GetID()==found[1].CityID,'carrier city identity changed before returning to Free Cities')
stage.Stage='CARRIER_RETURN_REQUEST';stage.Carrier.AICity=city:GetID();Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE',stage)
CityManager.TransferCity(city,stage.Carrier.Free)
return 'work-holding carrier transferred back to Free Cities; physical proof follows'
